name: com.maplith/bridge
title: Maplith Bridge
description: Share a folder of data files read-only over MCP, and fill it from PostgreSQL under a read-only role.

packageArguments.name: --dir
packageArguments.description: The folder of data files to share, read-only.

packageArguments.name: --token-file
packageArguments.description: The token file that maplith-bridge rotate-token wrote, readable by its owner only.

packageArguments.name: --port
packageArguments.description: The port on 127.0.0.1 to listen on.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer, then the token from the token file.

token.description: The token from the token file: 64 hexadecimal characters.
